column1: # BotScan shared-edge ranges (v1.234.0) — published CDN edge / platform egress networks.
# An address inside one of these ranges is a SHARED proxy: when it appears as the client
# in a web access log, the web server is logging the CDN, not the visitor. BotScan never
# bans it (shell emission + daemon apply), and reports the skip with this file's label.
# This is NOT a firewall whitelist: nothing here is accepted by the firewall, and other
# Authority: the provider's own published list, snapshotted at package build time; a
# newer copy fetched by `nftban trust` (cache, read-only here) is merged when present.
# Format: provider<TAB>list<TAB>CIDR   (v4 prefix >= /8, v6 prefix >= /16; others are rejected)
